text:
carla (AE): quick ask from NovaBank POC — they need tenant pinned to EU with BYOK, but allow failover to APAC for availability. they want a capped egress credit and list of APAC subprocessors. any precedent?

diego (SE): active-passive ok? do they require warm cache in APAC or cold failover?

carla (AE): active-passive, cold failover is fine. target: at most 3 failovers/month, each <10m. audit logs to their S3 and proof of which subprocessors handled traffic.

monique (Legal): we can do an SLA exception template. propose: (a) egress credit cap per month, (b) failover counting rules, (c) delivery of subproc attestations within 5 biz days. need exact fallback region and whether they accept Dedicated for BYOK.

hana (Infra): hosted fallback path: eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> ap-southeast-1 by default. public-hosted APAC uses our partner "asia-cloud-1" plus "logrelay-ap" for logs. BYOK + subproc exclusion requires Dedicated/Private.

liz (Sales Eng): pricing options: 1) EU reserved capacity (reduces chance of failover). 2) reserved + small APAC standby. 3) reserved + monthly egress credit cap (recommended for quick deal). ballpark: reserved adds ~30% on list, standby another ~40%. egress credit example: €1200/month for 2TB cap.

carla (AE): Monique — can you draft a short exception we can show the buyer? Hana — can you list exact subprocessors and SOC2 docs?

monique (Legal): yes. send me fallback target (single APAC region?) and confirmation they want credits (not billing).

hana (Infra): requested: limit fallback to ap-southeast-1 only. subprocessors likely touched if fallback occurs: "asia-cloud-1" (compute), "logrelay-ap" (logs), "edge-cache-ap" (optional CDN). will attach SOC2 PDFs. Dedicated avoids these.

liz (Sales Eng): i'll prepare two quote variants: Hosted + EU reserved + €1200 egress credit cap, and Dedicated (BYOK) with tailored pricing.

ci-bot: autoscale-sim: EU pool hit 92% at 2026-11-02T08:14:03Z, fallback simulated to ap-southeast-1 for 63s, logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/fallback-sims/1966667777.log :white_check_mark:

carla (AE): perfect — thanks team. i'll package legal template + pricing and loop in buyer.
